title: Elders
definition: Elders are qualified spiritual leaders called to shepherd, oversee, teach, and care for the local church under Christ.
summary: Elders are qualified men called to shepherd, oversee, teach, and guard the local church under Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the Chief Shepherd, and elders serve under His authority for the good of the flock.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses on spiritual oversight and shepherd leadership. Elders are not corporate executives or religious celebrities; they are servants accountable to the Chief Shepherd. Their work includes teaching, guarding doctrine, caring for souls, leading by example, and protecting the flock.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because churches suffer when leadership is built on charisma, control, or popularity instead of biblical qualification. Elders help the congregation remain nourished, protected, and ordered under Christ's rule. Their character matters as much as their ability.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pray for your elders by name where possible. Follow faithful shepherding with humility while testing all teaching by Scripture. Aspiring leaders should pursue godly character before public influence.
